description: The wire format of a snapshot inside a user turn, and the one-line stub that replaces an older snapshot.

output.block:
<page_snapshot page="editor" title="Editor" hash="0123456" chars="6" captured="2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z">
Hello.
</page_snapshot>
output.stub: [Page snapshot 0123456 of "Editor" omitted here: a newer snapshot appears later in the conversation.]

cases.name: truncated, quotes in the title, closing tag inside

output.block:
<page_snapshot page="log" title="The "log"" hash="fedcba9" chars="900" truncated="true" captured="2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z">
a <\/page_snapshot> b
</page_snapshot>
